_union_merge_note_2026-08-25: CONCURRENT-RUN COLLISION, resolved as a UNION per CLAUDE.md -- never by picking a side. Two runs executed the same post-open slot of 2026-08-25 independently: 13:42Z (this branch) and 13:45Z (merged to master as PR #637). The redundant trigger design (cron-job.org sub-hourly + the native hourly backstop) makes this intermittent and expected. BOTH runs did genuine, non-overlapping work and BOTH reached the SAME conclusion -- no entry, hedge held, artifacts rolled -- so this is cross-validation, not duplication. Critically, the latent danger the collision rule exists to prevent (two runs each believing they may open one entry, and both taking the same setup) did NOT materialise: neither run placed anything. This brief is the 13:45Z run's build; the 13:42Z run's independent build agreed on regime, levels and every gate, and its one unique measurement is folded into key_levels.QQQ below.
